parsed.explanation: The displayed inequality is false: D\setminus\{p\} has |D|-1 primes, so only 2^{|D|-1}\le w(D\setminus\{p\}) follows. This is a harmless one-symbol error: together with w(D\setminus\{p\})<a_1 it still bounds |D|, allowing Lemma 1 to prove that terminal members—and hence the relevant prime set P—are finite. The surrounding argument establishes the required finiteness mechanism, but no separate correctly written bound appears elsewhere.
